name: Santa's Quest
author: Addicting Games
description: Santa's Quest is a free puzzle game. Christmas can be a real puzzle and never has that been more obvious than right now when Santa himself is lost behind a sliding block puzzle. You need to intervene if you want all the good boys and girls of the world to get their presents this year. Santa is an extremely busy person who has a lot on his mind: presents, routes, who has been good, who has been bad, time-zones, flight paths. The man can't be concerned with the challenging but fun sliding block puzzle present in this game. Which is where you have to come in. Tap, click, slide, and unravel this mixed-up world as you help Santa walk his way from his sleigh to the houses laid square and true. This is an exciting and fast-paced puzzle game where you'll be challenged to slide blocks and open up a path to the chimneys. It is not time but you'll probably want to get it done pretty fast because time is of the essence.
